The '''Terminus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kallea sector/Legends|Kallea sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Terminus/Legends|Terminus]].
